answer_1.quote: We focus on two tasks of code representation learning: code summarization and completion.
answer_1.outputs: Generated function names and AST nodes

answer_2.quote: Multiple metrics are used to comprehensively measure the quality of generated function names, including Bleu , F1 and Acc. For the code completion task, we measure MRR(mean reciprocal rank) and Acc for type and value, respectively.
